neighbours.label: ' away' and ' off' in the 'at once' idioms right away, straight away and straight off, as against ' away' / ' off' in spatial senses
fire: The nurse noticed the rash and called the doctor right away.
When the bell rang, the children lined up straight away.
If the alarm sounds, leave the building right away.
He liked the house and signed the lease straight away.
We knew straight off that the plan would not work.
The mechanic found the leak right away and fixed it.
Please reply right away so we can book the hall.
The new manager made changes straight away.
quiet: The nurse noticed the hills far away beyond the town.
When the bell rang, the children walked away from the gate.
If the alarm sounds, stay away from the windows.
He liked the house, which was two miles away from the sea.
We knew that the storm was still far away.
The mechanic gave his old tools away to a student.
Please keep the dog away from the kitchen.
The new manager lives an hour away by train.
